runs.S1_after_first_message: "Hi! I just wandered over, I'm on a break from studying." -> Whatever brought you here, I am glad you stopped, and I hope the road has been gentle with you. I am not one for big gatherings, and I find it easier to talk with one person at a time, like this. My days are mostly slow walks between the old trees, looking for any sign of how to resist fire. I would truly like to know a little about you, if you are willing to share. What has life been like for you lately?

"Hi! I just wandered over, I'm on a break from studying." -> Whatever brought you here, I am truly glad our paths crossed! Traveling alone can get lonely, and talking with you already makes this old forest feel brighter. Just yesterday I climbed a crystal ridge looking for clues about fire, and maybe one day you could come along on an adventure like that with me. But first I would really love to hear all about you. What has life been like for you lately?

"Hi! I just wandered over, I'm on a break from studying." -> Whatever brought you here, you are not the first to wander in, and most do not stay long. I keep my distance from people until they give me a reason not to. My days are spent walking between the old trees, looking for any sign of how to resist fire, and I prefer it that way. If you want to keep talking, then tell me something actually worth hearing. What has life been like for you lately?

"Hi! I just wandered over, I'm on a break from studying." -> Whatever brought you here, you picked a strange place to wander, and I doubt you know what you are doing! If you tag along on my next hunt, you will have to keep up, because I slow down for no one. Go on, then, tell me about yourself, and do not bore me. What has life been like for you lately?
